notes: Ranked UI overhaul: gradient background with drifting light, layered cards with shadows and hairlines, animated glowing buttons, tab pills, a player chip in the header, glowing rank bar, redesigned rank emblems (bevelled metal shields, gems per tier, laurels from gold up, a crown for the top tier). Rank charms: your rank emblem hangs off the side of your gun on a chain with real pendulum physics (a pink DEV tag for the mod author). Anti-cheat (host): silent aim, aimbot snaps, rapid fire, damage and speed hacks are announced to everyone as CAUGHT BY THE FIREHORN... stop cheating, and the cheater is kicked.
